mentions.name: 1000 Books Before Kindergarten Tracker
mentions.description: This app tracks a child's progress toward the '1000 books before kindergarten' reading goal. It includes barcode scanning to add books to the library and a rotation feature that schedules books based on when each was last read and how much the reader enjoys it, with less-liked books appearing less frequently.
mentions.audience: Reading-tracking app for a child's '1000 books before kindergarten' goal, shared in semi-public TestFlight with friends who have kids.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on an app to track my son's 1000 books before kindergarten. I've also added QOL features like barcode scanning for adding books to the library and creating a rotation based on the last time the book was read and whether I actually enjoy reading it.
